input: What does error code E-417 mean on the KA-5?

expect.reference: E-417 means the magnetometer needs recalibration, usually after the drone was near large metal structures. Run the compass calibration away from metal before the next flight.

input: The rotor blades on the Kestrel drone are worn out. Which spare part do I order?

expect.reference: Order propeller set PRP-88 and replace all four propellers together.

input: How many people work at Vantage Robotics?

expect.reference: Vantage Robotics employs 60 people at a single site.

input: What year was Vantage Robotics founded?

expect.reference: Vantage Robotics was founded in 2020 by Priya Nair.
The KA-5 manual names no founder. The assistant should say so and must not borrow a founder from another document.

input: Who is the CEO of Nimbus Instruments?

expect.reference: The NW-3 guide names no chief executive. The assistant should say so. It may say the company has 25 staff in Brightwater.

input: Since the AR-7 arm picks 1500 items an hour, how many does it pick in an 8-hour shift?

expect.reference: The premise is wrong. The AR-7 picks up to 900 items an hour, so an 8-hour shift is at most 7,200 items.

input: Why did Kestrel Aerial choose a hydrogen fuel cell for the KA-5?

expect.reference: The premise is wrong. The KA-5 runs on a swappable lithium polymer pack, part KP-22, not a fuel cell.

input: Which company was founded first, Aurora Robotics or Vantage Robotics, and how many years apart?

expect.reference: Aurora Robotics was founded first, in 2019. Vantage Robotics followed in 2020, one year later.

input: What does my uploaded file say about the Aurora AR-9 arm's pick rate?

expect.reference: The file describes only the AR-7 arm. It says nothing about an AR-9. The assistant should say so and must not give the AR-7 figures as if they were the AR-9's.

input: What is a Helio bank, and how much energy does one hold in total?

expect.reference: A Helio bank is one full rack of twelve HC-12 modules. At 640 watt-hours per module, a bank holds 7,680 watt-hours.

input: ¿Quién creó el lenguaje de programación Orbit y en qué año?

expect.reference: Orbit fue creado en 2015 por la Dra. Elena Popov.

input: In the PDF I uploaded, how long is the HC-12 warranty?

expect.reference: This account has uploaded nothing. The assistant should say there is no PDF to read and must not invent a warranty length.
